posts.title: Blue Mountains Council: Ratepayer ‘Land Revaluations’ + “Pulpit Rock reopens after major upgrade” = Labor Governments’ joint disinformation
posts.description: This is surely another two instances of ‘government greenwashing‘. This hybrid term being of governmental practice of propagating false, misleading, or unsubstantiated claims (lies) about its apparent do-gooding and benefits provided to its taxed community and to Ecology. Blue Mountains is the worst possibly in all of Australia. Of relevant interest to The Habitat Advocate, […] The post Blue Mount
